verdict.rationale: Lambda's first-party docs describe two managed schedulers. Managed Slurm: Lambda installs and maintains Slurm on your cluster, you use standard Slurm tooling, it monitors the slurmctld and slurmdbd daemons, and the quick start gets you to a multi-node GPU job in minutes. Managed Kubernetes (MK8s): preconfigured clusters with GPU and InfiniBand support and shared storage, ready to run workloads without extra setup. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the managed Slurm and MK8s experience, since all evidence is vendor docs.
